ecological_question: Are species-specific wet-versus-dry recruitment responses predictable from independently compiled amphibian ecological traits?

source_effects.response: Haldane-corrected log odds log((wet_gains+0.5)/(dry_losses+0.5)) for the 29 eligibility-qualified species

taxonomy.normalization: Trim whitespace; use first two binomial tokens; case-sensitive genus/species after whitespace normalization.
match_order: if exact fails, apply only the frozen genus aliases below and require a unique exact binomial match

primary_trait.name: climatic_activity_axis
primary_trait.definition: wet_active - dry_active, where wet_active=max(Wet_warm,Wet_cold) and dry_active=max(Dry_warm,Dry_cold); values -1,0,+1
primary_trait.hypothesis: Species whose independently compiled activity seasonality is more wet-associated have more positive wet-recruitment log odds.

secondary_traits.model_rule: One univariate species-level model per trait; binary traits require both levels and >=12 complete species; body size requires >=12 finite positive values.
secondary_traits.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across estimable secondary traits only.
secondary_traits.status: exploratory finite family; no directional headline claim

model.estimator: weighted least squares with inverse-variance weights and HC3 covariance across species
model.no_phylogenetic_correction: Trait test is a first ecological screen on <=29 species; lack of phylogenetic correction is a stated limitation and blocks a strong evolutionary claim.

missingness.report: matched species, unmatched species, missingness per tested trait

interpretation.primary_positive: Supports rainfall as a species-selective ecological filter aligned with independently compiled climatic activity strategy.
interpretation.primary_null: Species-selective rainfall response remains real, but AmphiBIO coarse seasonality does not explain it.
boundary: Does not establish hydroperiod preference because AmphiBIO seasonality is climatic activity seasonality, not breeding-pond hydroperiod.
Does not establish causal rainfall effects.
Post-opening ecological extension frozen before external trait values were read.
